title: Vital Signs & Clinical Assessment
summary: Core physiological parameters including BP, pulse, respiration rate, and body temperature protocols.
keyPoints: Always assess baseline before administering cardiac medications.

title: Antihypertensive Classifications
summary: Mechanisms, nursing considerations, and side effects for ACE inhibitors, Beta-blockers, and CCBs.
keyPoints: ACE Inhibitors (-pril): Monitor for persistent dry cough and hyperkalemia.
Beta-Blockers (-olol): Check apical pulse prior to administration (hold if <60 bpm).
Calcium Channel Blockers: Monitor for peripheral edema and hypotension.

title: Therapeutic Communication
summary: Verbal and non-verbal techniques to establish trust, active listening, and rapport in psychiatric care.
keyPoints: Use open-ended statements to encourage patient expression.
Avoid offering false reassurance or unsolicited personal advice.
Utilize active silence and reflective clarifying statements.

title: Infection Control & Asepsis
summary: Standard and transmission-based precautions, hand hygiene guidelines, and sterile field maintenance.
keyPoints: Hand hygiene is the single most effective method to prevent healthcare-associated infections.
PPE donning order: Gown -> Mask -> Goggles/Shield -> Gloves.
PPE doffing order: Gloves -> Goggles/Shield -> Gown -> Mask.

title: Analgesic & Opioid Safety
summary: Safe administration protocols for non-opioid and opioid analgesics, monitoring, and reversal agents.
keyPoints: Assess respiratory status before administering opioid analgesics.
Naloxone is the opioid reversal agent for severe respiratory depression.
Monitor liver function tests for high-dose acetaminophen therapy.

title: Anxiety & Crisis Intervention
summary: Recognizing continuum levels of anxiety and applying crisis de-escalation strategies.
keyPoints: Severe anxiety or panic requires short, clear, and direct communication.
Maintain patient and environment safety during acute crisis states.
Guide deep breathing and grounding exercises once severe panic de-escalates.
